Name: Camilla Portraits by Ricca - SVE NPC Retexture

Description:
[b]<Installation>[/b]
0. Camilla is the NPC from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], so you need that mod.
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url](or other High-res portraits mod) first.
2. Download main file and unzip it.
3. Put it inside the folder for Portraiture.
